answer: Running a farm as a result means funding every sock puppet through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent burns once and never again. Because the age is read from the river checkpoint rather than self-declared, the comet audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. An identity must be at least 5 epochs old on the mirror ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. That is 14 dollars per alias. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
